Coram : SANJAY KISHAN KAUL, K.M. JOSEPH
Hindu Marriage Act, 1955: s. 13(1)(ia) – Petition seeking divorce – By husband – Trial Court passed decree of divorce – High Court set aside the decree – Appeal to Supreme Court – Held: The High Court has brushed aside the allegations as wear and tear of an extent that continuity of marriage is fruitless – Though the ground of ‘irretrievable breakdown of marriage’ has not been inserted as a ground for divorce under the Act, in exercise of jurisdiction u/Art. 142 of the Constitution, in order to put a quiet us to the dispute,
Decision Date : 17-12-2019 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 9318/2019 | Bench : 2 Judges
